text:
ITEM 1 | Pizza slice, triangular wedge about 15 cm long and 8 cm wide at crust, golden-brown blistered crust with charred spots on edges; top has melted pale cheese, red sauce patches, thin red onion rings, dark sliced mushroom pieces, and a dark olive slice; slightly glossy from cheese, holds shape | 110

ITEM 2 | Pile of bite-sized cooked chicken pieces, roughly 2-3 cm chunks, off-white to golden-brown with light browning and some crisp edges, glossy with a thin sauce coating, piled in a mound covering about one-third of the plate's right side | 150

ITEM 3 | Stir-fried vegetables mixed with chicken: Brussels sprout halves dark green with charred edges, zucchini rounds and yellow squash chunks about 2-3 cm, bright green and yellow pieces, scattered among chicken; slightly oily sheen | 60

ITEM 4 | Dried red chili pieces, dark red and wrinkled, about 3-4 cm long, scattered among the chicken and vegetables; dry surface | 5

ITEM 5 | Light brown glossy sauce residue, thin smears and spots on the plate around the food and pizza crumbs, slightly oily sheen | 10
